whatsappMessage:
Hi Team The Fifth Avenue Bakery & Cafe,

I noticed your bakery & cafe has strong 4.2★ ratings with 365+ reviews in South Gandhi Maidan, but your current Netlify site can be upgraded to a lightning-fast mobile-first web app.

Maine aapke cafe ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp table booking, celebration cake inquiry, aur popular menu categories integrate ki hain:

🔗 https://fifth-avenue-bakerycafe.netlify.app/

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team The Fifth Avenue Bakery & Cafe, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp table reservation, celebration cake inquiries, and a showcase of your pet-friendly vibe in South Gandhi Maidan. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga?"
